title: Adobe security advisory (AV26-1205)
description: As of November 24, 2026, Adobe is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Cloud Service (CS)
	Prior to or equal to 2026.11.29643

Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) 6.5
	Prior to or equal to Service Pack 26 / 25 / 24 - Cumulative Hotfix for GRANITE-76751
Prior to or equal to Service Pack 26 / 25 / 24 - Cumulative Hotfix for GRANITE-76751

Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) 6.5 LTS
	Prior to or equal to Service Pack 3 / 2 / 1 - Cumulative Hotfix for GRANITE-76751
Prior to or equal to Service Pack 3 / 2 / 1 - Cumulative Hotfix for GRANITE-76751
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
